name: fonts
description: Self-hosted font strategy: sync-fonts copies fontsource woff2 into public/fonts and generates @font-face with measured fallback metrics; FontPreload.astro.
next: Add the font packages (pnpm add @fontsource/<family> or @fontsource-variable/<family>), edit fonts.config.json, run node scripts/fonts/sync-fonts.mjs (replaces the empty src/styles/fonts.manifest.json stub that keeps `astro check` green before the first sync), THEN add @import './fonts.generated.css'; to src/styles/global.css (it does not exist before the sync).
Put <FontPreload /> in <head> (BaseLayout preload slot); name the families in the theme tokens (--font-display/--font-sans/--font-mono).
